errors.quote: There are $b+1$ rounds on prefix slots and $qK$ on chunks, $\ell$ in all.
errors.problem: The round at h=\ell-1 happens only if there are long axes. When every axis is short there are b prefix rounds and \ell-1 rounds in all. The paper says 'at most b+1\le K rounds on prefix slots' and 'at most \ell rounds'. The same exactness carries into 'the \ell rounds leave error below'. The bounds are unaffected.
